summary: title: Hugging Face tags: open-source/platform, model-hub, community # Hugging Face ## Overview Hugging Face is the dominant platform for open-weight model distribution, community benchmarks, and ML collaboration. Often called the "GitHub of ML." ## Key Services | Service | Description | |---------|-------------| | Model Hub | 1M+ models across all modalities | | Datasets | 200K+ datasets for training/evaluation | | Spaces | Demo hosting for ML applications | | Leaderboards | Open LLM Leaderboard, task-specific rankings | | Inference API | Serverless model inference | | Transformers | Open-source library for model usage | ## Open LLM Leaderboard The Open LLM Leaderboard is the primary community-driven benchmark for open-weight models. Key metrics include: - ARC — Reasoning and common sense - HellaSwag — Commonsense NLI - MMLU — Multi-task language understanding - TruthfulQA — Truthfulness and factuality - Winogrande — Pronoun disambiguation ## Market Position - Strengths : Network effects (most models published here), free tier access, active community, comprehensive tooling - Weaknesses : Quality control challenges (anyone can publish), benchmark manipulation risk - vs.
